## About Me

I am a PhD student at Monash University. My research interests fall in financial econometrics, Bayesian statistics and time series forecasting. The project that I am working on involves state space models, Bayesian nonparametric methods and applications on the financial market.

On this website, I share my PhD journey, my research interests and a list of my presentations.

## Education

🎓 Doctor of Philosophy, Monash University

🎓 Bachelor of Commerce (First Class Honors), Monash University

## Current Research Project

📝 **Jump Modeling with Dirichlet Process Mixture** (with [Ole Maneesoonthorn](https://sites.google.com/view/o-maneesoonthorn/home), [Yong Song](https://sites.google.com/view/ysong1), [Wei Wei](https://sites.google.com/site/wwei0936))
